procedural_matters: GER 77 was represented by Editha WENDEBORN (crew).
GER 376 was represented by Garloff LANGENBECK-WALDECK (helm).
GER 26 represented by Jesse Lindstädt presented evidence as a witness.
Jules Lange, the windward mark layer, presented evidence as a witness.
GER 77 informed GER 376 of the protest at the first reasonable opportunity as required by RRS 60.2(b)(3).
facts: At the time of the incident in Formula 18 race 12 wind was 12 kn of wind and a flat sea.
GER 77, sailing close-hauled on port tack about 50 m to leeward of the offset mark 1A on the port lay line to mark 1.
GER 376 reaching on starboard was about to round the offset mark 1A.
GER 77 bore away from the direction of GER 376 course, and was overlapped close to windward of NED 666.
When GER 376 passed the offset mark 1A, she bore away rapidly by about 90°.
There was contact, at approximately 90° between boats, between GER 376 port hull bow and the port side hull of GER 77, causing a 40 x 30 cm hole to GER 77.
There was injury (splinters from the broken carbon tiller in the helms arm).
GER 376 and GER 77 immediately retired from the race and returned to shore.
conclusions: When changing course, GER 376 the right-of-way boat failed to give GER 77 room to keep clear, and broke RRS 16.1.
GER 376 did not avoid contact with GER 77 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
GER 77 on port tack failed to keep clear of GER 376 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
Since it was not reasonable possible for GER 77 to avoid contact with GER 376 she did not break rule 14(a).
Since GER 77 was compelled to break RRS 10 as a consequence of GER 376 breaking RRS 16.1, she is exonerated under RRS 43.1(a) for this breach.

GER 77`s score in race 12 was made significantly worse through no fault of her own by physical damage because of the action of GER 376 that broke a RRS 16.1 and GER 376 took the appropriate penalty. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(2) are met.
decision: The protest is upheld. Since GER 376 took an applicable penalty, she is not further penalized under RRS 60.5(c)(2).

Redress is given to GER 77. GER 77 is to be scored in race 12 points equal to the average, to the nearest tenth of a point (0,05 to be rounded upward) of races 1 – 11. No other boat’s score shall change.
